# Public authorization fixtures

Synthetic example-domain URLs and a public client identifier are authored for these tests (repository license). No real accounts, secrets or package content are used. `t27_tests.rs` freezes the authorize request (`response_type=code`, S256 challenge, resource, redirect URI, unpredictable state), one-shot matching callback, and URL elicitation (`mode`, `message`, `url`, `elicitationId`) shapes. Reference: frozen Codex `codex-mcp/src/mcp/auth.rs`; hosted connector parsing in `auth_elicitation.rs` is excluded. User responses are replaced at the existing question boundary; question registration, tenant ownership and cleanup remain real. Browser/provider and desktop rendering acceptance remain separate evidence and are not established by these fixtures.
